scenarios.description: Overlapping affected outages merged deterministically with one unaffected incident
scenarios.document_body:
INC-101: Sequencer RPC gateway in eu-central-1 suffered complete unavailability starting at 2026-10-05T14:00:00Z due to BGP route leak; full service recovery achieved at 2026-10-05T14:45:00Z.
INC-102: Sequencer RPC gateway in eu-central-1 experienced a secondary outage at 2026-10-05T14:30:00Z during failover; service was fully restored at 2026-10-05T15:15:00Z.
INC-103: Analytics indexer in us-west-2 had elevated latency at 2026-10-06T09:00:00Z; eu-central-1 Sequencer RPC gateway experienced no outage and remained unaffected.
